entities.summary: Nick Srnicek is a Canadian writer and academic. He is currently a lecturer in Digital Economy in the Department of Digital Humanities, King's College London. Srnicek is associated with the political theory of accelerationism and a post-scarcity economy. Nick Srnicek was a philosophers & thinkers from Canada (b. 1982-12-13, Canada). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
